q: Is there a deadline to claim CCTS offset credits after the monitoring period?
title: Deadline to claim CCTS offset credits
short: Yes. Issuance requests must be filed in date order, starting with the first monitoring period, and every request for a crediting period must be submitted within two years after that period ends. Miss the deadline and BEE no longer issues credits for that crediting period.
audience: Registered CCTS offset projects and their verifiers

ul: Requests go in chronological order, starting from the first monitoring period.
Requests for reductions in a crediting period must be submitted within two years after it ends.
BEE checks the monitoring report for completeness within 10 working days; an incomplete request can be resubmitted within 15 working days.
A subject matter expert reviews it within 30 calendar days, then the Technical Committee and NSC-ICM decide.
Credits are issued after the INR 5 per credit issuance fee is paid.

p: Book verification for each monitoring period soon after it closes. A verifier who raises queries can take months, and any gap in metering or invoices for a month leaves nothing for the verifier to test.

senseible: Senseible keeps fuel and electricity invoices as dated, fingerprinted monthly records, the consumption data a project's monitoring report and its verifier will ask to trace.

sources.label: BEE, Detailed Procedure for Offset Mechanism under CCTS, Version 1.0 (effective 27 March 2025)
